title: eludite.browser.network_body input
description: Read the response body of a request the page made, by its `request_id` from eludite.browser.network (Network.getResponseBody): the JSON an API answered, the HTML of a document, a script. Text comes back as `body`, binary data as `body_base64`, either cut at `max_bytes` (default 65,536) with `truncated`. The browser keeps bodies of requests since the tab was opened, within its buffers (50 MB per resource, 200 MB in all); a body it no longer has, or never had (a failed request, a redirect), fails the command and says so. Permission class read; refused when the solution's policy sets `browser.network_bodies` to `deny`. Next: eludite.browser.network for other requests.
x-eludite-escalates: Refused for agents when the solution's policy sets `browser.network_bodies` to `deny`.

max_bytes.description: The most bytes of the body to answer (default 65536).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
